featured_reviews.name: Abhilasha Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have visited this place multiple times, when it comes to chinese food this is best option nearby, Well we have decided to celebrate my In-laws wedding anniversary over there however we had very disappointing experience. We went to FOC expecting to try several dishes listed on the menu, but most of them were not available. Nearly every time we ordered something, the staff said it was “not available today,” which made the menu feel pointless. Not even fried noodles which is basis in any Chinese restaurant was not available. Their special dishes was not available

After going through multiple options, we were left with only a few basic choices. It was frustrating because we specifically came to try certain dishes, but the restaurant couldn’t provide them. If a restaurant lists items on the menu, they should actually have them available.

Overall, poor planning and a very unsatisfying experience. I wouldn’t recommend coming here unless you’re okay with most of the menu being unavailable. Pathetic service we have experience on our special day. If they don't know how to handle Online order along with restaurant they should not run restaurant, either run dining or cloud kitchen. Not going to visit nor recommending this place any more.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of my new favourite!
*Food-Tasty chinese food, has good quality and quantity.
Must try Hong Kong rice, pot rice, tripe Schezwan rice and chopper rice.
I loved their honey chilli potatoes and Thai green curry.
They do not add too much food colour and that's the plus, The flavour of every dish is different.
They serve free kimchi Salad.
The food is not very spicy so even kids can eat.
The take away packs are of 1000ml containers (for rice/noodles) which Is enough to serve 2-3 people.

*Ambience and price - ambience is dim and has wall paited with Chinese symbols, they have nice hand painted lamps, there is Seating area down as well as on 1st floor.
Price are a bit high compared to the local Chinese places but totally worth the quality and quantity

*Attributes - The enterance is not accessible ♿❌
They accept digital payments
The place is very clean and tidy
Staff is polite.
Takeaway and delivery is available
Group and family friendly place.

featured_reviews.name: NomNom Mumbaikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to Chinese or pan Asian food I can only think of Flavours of China. It has been a saviour from quite sometime now. It truly satisfy my craving for Chinese also my hunger. I don’t even remember the count for how many times I have ordered from this place now.

The menu here is vast and has got lots of variety with them. Starting from soups till dessert they have got it all whether it is Thai curry, lollipop, chopper rice, pot rice or fried wanton, noodles, their signature dish FOC chicken I love them all. Their signature dish is my most favourite one. With every bite you know the chicken, the vegetable or the ingredients whatever they use is fresh. Also they pack the food nicely and deliver it safely to us.

Not only that they also think about their customers by providing free gift of certain percent discount on our next order. One of the best pas Asian restaurant in the neighbourhood of Borivali. Highly recommend food from here.

featured_reviews.name: Vipul G
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wok express is spreading its wings slowly but firmly across the city.. Most of them are like takeaway joints .. I happened to visit their bkc outlet on Sunday eve, my first experience at wok express, n it was good.. Wok express do serve oriental food at very reasonable rates.. The bkc outlet has 3 tables n few chairs to sit.. It's a very clean hygienic place.. I started here with zesty lemon n coriander soup.. This healthy n delicious soup had refreshing combination of lemon, coriander n veggies in it with a thick consistency .. We tried crispy tempura roll sushi n they were scrumptious.. Carrot, Onion, Tempura flour and Sesame oil rolled in sweet and sour rice are served along with soya sauce.. It was too good n one of the best sushi I have ever had.. Had kung pao potatoes n it was also very good .. Baby potatoes, cooked in Chinese sauce, are served along with roasted peanuts on it.. It was delectable n quite filling one.. We also tried chilli Paneer bao n I found it ok.. Chopped pieces of succulent Paneer are marinated well in spicy chilli basil sauce n are served in super soft fluffy bao.. I found it too much saucy to my liking.. Wok express is known for its wok n they here do serve some really amazing wok our here.. One can directly order for chef recommended wok box which I guess will be great to do.. One can also customise n choose between rice n noodles, sauces, veggies n condiments n prepare wok according to their liking if you are particular about what u eat.. Also there are sizes to choose from n along with combo deals with drinks it's very reasonable.. I had Bangkok ramen noodles n it was too good.. This wok box had ramen noodles along with veggies n sauce were topped with burnt garlic.. It was hot, tasty n treat to my taste buds.. Food overall was good here n let me warn u if u don't like medium spicy or spicy food this place is not for you.. We also tried popcorn n peach iced bubble tea n I found both to be good in flavour but frankly Tapioca pearls in it were not that great n i will recommend to try bubble tea without tapioca pearls in it.. Will like the management to work on tapioca pearls n improve on it.. Service was good n staff were very helpful with their recommendations.. As food is prepared fresh expect 10/15 mins wait for ur order.. Overall it was decent experience out here n I'm surely trying their other woks served out here in future

My recommendations - Zesty lemon n coriander soup, crispy tempura roll sushi, kung pao potatoes, Bangkok ramen noodles

featured_reviews.name: ravindra gomase
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good food overall, but a few misses in what I ordered

I liked the food overall, though some dishes worked better than others.

I had the Signature Ramen. The broth was quite good, and I really enjoyed the variety of toppings — squid, prawns, chicken, bamboo shoots, veggies, and boiled egg. The toppings were definitely the highlight. That said, I didn’t like the thickness of the noodles, which was a bit of a turn-off. Also, the prawns were not the best, while the other toppings were more enjoyable.

I was initially planning to order Nasi Goreng, but went with the Spicy Bangkok Fried Rice instead — and unfortunately, that turned out to be the wrong choice. The rice texture was nice, but the overall flavor and spice level were underwhelming. It came with fried tofu, which had an amazing texture — crispy on the outside and melt-in-the-mouth inside — but the tofu itself was quite bland.

I feel like this place has a lot to offer, but I probably just picked the wrong dishes this time.

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect Place to Satisfy your Asian food cravings!

I love Asian cuisine and thus keep trying various places. Found this gem place and ordered a lunch from here. Food was delivered piping hot in perfect packaging and on time. They have wide range of options to choose from for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians!

We tried Singapore style Mei fun noodles, exotic veg sichuan gravy, Dynamite Paneer and their unique, must try chinese falooda!
Quality food delivered to doorstep.

Paneer Dynamite, if you love spicy food then this is a must try! Fresh paneer chunks so well tossed in super spicy mayo and served with some broccoli in case if you can't handle the spiciness!!

Singapore style mei fun noodles, loaded with fresh veggies this thin noodles were really good in taste. We paired it with exotic veg sichuan gravy and it was really a good combination. Gravy was loaded with sichuan chilli and Exotic vegetables. Perfect taste and good consistency considering its a delivery!

Coming to the best part, Chinese Falooda! Yes, this unique dessert is definitely a must try. Loaded with so many fresh fruits, cream and lip smacking taste. Do try this unique dessert, definitely worth it!

Overall, Top notch quality Pan Asian food with lots of amazing options. Excellent packaging and food delivered on time. We really loved the food from this place.

Ordered from this place for its Asian cuisine...

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Pitnaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered up lunch from here a few days back. Packaging of the boxes was good but there was a bit of oil spillage from the Schezwan container. Quality was good and fresh as well. Portion size was also worth the pricing.
.
I ordered the following items: -
.
1. Oriental spiced chicken wings: - the sauce of this wings was super unique. An excellent blend of spices in a sweet sauce. Was garnished with sesame seeds. Tender af meat with the marination flavors inside the meat as well. Costing had a spicy flavor to it followed by a dominant kick of garlic. Very unique fragrance as well. NOT YOUR REGULAR CHICKEN WINGS ! Recommended 🏁
.
2.  Crispy lotus root: - these were crisp af ! Remained crisp even after a while. The sauce had a mild savory spicy flavor. Strong presence of ginger and garlic. Had kick from chillies as well ! pieces of bell peppers did give it a nice crunch
.
3. Sesame butter garlic basil chicken:- had tons of contrasting flavors all in one but they went banger altogether as well. The crunch of the sesame seeds paired really well with the mild- garlicky flavor of the sauce and the freshness of the basil. Chicken was juicy on the inside with a nice light batter coating on the outside which soaked all the sauces. Definitely a must try. RECOMMENDED 🏁

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tuki!
What a amazing place to try out Asian cuisine. Long time after I decided to try Asian cuisine online. So I was looking for Chinese restaurant and saw Tuki, So thought trying out this place. So went through reviews and ordered food from Tuki.

1. Korean Chicken wings🍗
Truly I love the way the food was packed and delivered. I ordered Korean Chicken wings which was quite amazing, as it was my first time trying Korean food tbh I loved the wings. The chicken wings were perfectly marinated and fried. The chicken wings were tossed in hot Korean sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds. Must try!

2. Chicken Singapore Rice:-
I had this many times, so thought let's try it from Tuki asian. It was also nice. Combination of sweet and spicy flavours served with fried chicken pieces. Their were lots of Veggies in it. I would rate 9/10. surely can try out this!

Pan fried Chicken Noodles🍜
People who love Noodles should definitely try out this dish. We received two separate containers. In one container there was Fried noodles and in other gravy. The noodles and gravy were so delicious we really loved it. Gravy was loaded with lots of chicken pieces and veggies. Amazing dish. Highly recommended.

4. Chicken in Hunan Sauce:-
This dish was also good. Fried chicken pieces tossed in gravy similar to Chicken Manchurian. Great add on to hakka noodles and chicken fried rice.

I genuinely loved this place because they serve authentic Asian cuisine. Would also recommend to try out this place.
Cheers Tuki Asian team🥂

featured_reviews.review_text:
Tuki is one of the amazing place to order food and specially starters if you have friends or sudden guests at your place and they want to chill out at home.   They serve amazing starters, just perfect for any house parties, etc...
They serve authentic Pan Asian food, their packaging is also properly done and is leak proof...
We ordered some amazing starters from like :-

1) Korean fish - these were huge pieces of fish tossed in a sweetish and spicy garlicy schezwan chutney, it was spicy but still had a sweet touch in every bite, great option for spicy lovers...

2) Kung Pao chicken - these were thin sheets and strips of chicken tossed in a yummy gravy which was sweet and tangy and it had lot of garlic pieces and other veggies like onions, capsicum, spring onions and lots of cashews in it, amazing option and Gooding quantity...

Over all the seafood dishes are very good here and the quantity is also very good...

Here is what we tried:

•Soy wine chili chicken: A unique dish but it felt like it required a little more of flavour balance especially considering it had soy and wine.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Dixit
featured_reviews.review_text:
P.F. Chang's | Oberoi Sky City Mall, Borivali East
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐.5 (3.5/5)

P.F. Chang’s is a world-renowned brand celebrated for its upscale take on Pan-Asian cuisine and its signature scratch-kitchen approach. Known for blending traditional wok techniques with a modern American-Asian fusion, it has long been a go-to for fans of Chinese and Southeast Asian Flavors.
I recently visited the P.F. Chang’s at Oberoi Sky City Mall in Borivali East for a family dinner. Despite it being a busy evening with a healthy crowd, we were lucky enough to get a table for the family instantly with zero waiting time. The staff here is courteous and provides great service, which made the initial experience very welcoming.
As a vegetarian, I explored their veg menu options. While the taste and quantity of the veg dishes were decent enough, they didn't particularly stand out as extraordinary.
There is definitely room for improvement. The music was quite loud, making it difficult to have a relaxed conversation. I did request the staff to reduce the volume, but unfortunately, it didn’t seem like anything was done about it.
Because of the noise level, food and the overall vibe, it didn't quite hit that "fine dining" mark I was expecting.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the first time I have been to any of their restaurants in Mumbai and they seem to have a few of them located across Mumbai. The restaurant is spacious, the seating is well laid out and you can move about without disturbing other patrons. The menu is really really good with plenty of vegetarian and non-vegetarian choices but I think the non-vegetarian selection is way better. Staff is courteous, service is quick and the food is a tad expensive but I am okay with this because the food was just yum. We ordered the California Roll and the wok charred chicken starters. The wok charred chicken entree is the best chicken I’ve had in a long time and I highly recommend you try it. You will go for another serving guaranteed. For the mains it was chilli garlic vegetables and Chang’ fried rice and it did not disappoint. I just wish the rice portion were a little bigger. The mains are enough for two so order accordingly if you are group of people. They do not serve alcohol yet and have no idea if that’s how it’s going to be. They have a bunch of mocktails and I tried the Zen Garden mocktail which is really good and paired well with all the food we ordered. Oh and despite being a little full we still went ahead and ordered the sticky tiger pudding. And damn it was so good. Did not feel any guilt at all that I might have had a wee little too much for lunch. They do bill you for service charge but will be happy to take it off the bill on request. It’s a great first experience and I will be showing up here again for sure. Do give it a try though you are at the Sky City Mall at Borivali East for whatever reason…..

featured_reviews.name: Anirban Ghosh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐½
Visually stunning interiors with cherry blossom installations, warm lighting, and plush seating. Despite being in a mall, it feels calm and thoughtfully designed. Bonus points for being family-friendly.

Service: ⭐⭐⭐⭐½
Smooth, well-paced service throughout. The team kept us informed about wait times, which really helps set expectations. We were also given one of the largest tables since we were dining with our 4-month-old daughter—small gesture, big comfort win.
Service charge was justified, though a prior heads-up would’ve been ideal.

Food: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Everything clicked.

Original Dynamite Shrimp — Crispy, perfectly coated, and deeply satisfying.

Hunan Chilli Chicken — Properly spicy with a well-balanced sauce.

Hakka Noodles (Chicken) — Handmade, beautifully seasoned, and good enough to enjoy on its own.

Orange Chicken — A tricky dish done right; sweetness and tanginess were spot on.
Also loved the complimentary sauces—especially the sriracha, which kept pulling me back for “just one more dip.”

Value: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
At ~₹1,300 per person, the experience absolutely delivers. They clearly know their Asia-Pacific niche. One extra star will come the day alcohol is added 😄.

Final Thoughts:
Polished food, thoughtful service, and a comfortable setting make this a reliable choice. Tip: great spot if you’re dining with family—space and comfort are handled well.

Would I return? ✔️
